cards.name: Shrine of Twilight
cards.text: Herald Cho'gall. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: This is where Cho'gall puts all his Old God merch.

cards.name: Siamat
cards.text: Battlecry: Gain 2 of Rush, Taunt, Divine Shield, or Windfury (your choice).
cards.flavorText: TAUNT. TAUNT.

cards.name: Sigil of Cinder
cards.text: At the start of your next turn,& deal 6 damage randomly split among all enemies.
cards.flavorText: It's the emblem of fire season.

cards.name: Sigil of Hatching
cards.text: At the start of your next turn, summon three 3/1 Shredclaws with Rush.
cards.flavorText: This quick and easy one egg recipe only takes one turn to prepare and will potentially even leave you with leftovers!

cards.name: Sigil of the Seas
cards.text: At the start of your next turn, summon a 3/3 Naga with Taunt.
cards.flavorText: If your opponent has lethal, you're Naganna make it.

cards.name: Silent Strike
cards.text: Give a minion +3 Attack. If it's Stealthed, deal its Attack damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: Be very very quiet... I'm hunting Defias.

cards.name: Silithid Queen
cards.text: Rush Kindred:& Give your hero +5 Attack this turn.
cards.flavorText: Yaaaaaaass Silithid Queen, stiiiing.

cards.name: Silvermoon Portal
cards.text: Give a minion +2/+2. Summon a random 2-Cost minion.
cards.flavorText: What's Millhouse Manastorm doing in Silvermoon?

cards.name: Sindragosa's Triumph
cards.text: Deal 8 damage to a minion. Reduce the Cost of a random card in your hand by the excess damage.
cards.flavorText: When Sindragosa and her beloved fight side by side, nothing can stand in their way.

cards.name: Sinestra
cards.text: Colossal +2 Your spells from other classes cast twice.
cards.flavorText: Though she holds no love for her former spouse, Sinestra is willing to work with him if it means her Twilight brood can finally inherit what remains of Azeroth.

cards.name: Sinful Steed
cards.text: Reborn. This is Reborn with full Health and enchantments.
cards.flavorText: A kingdom, a kingdom... literally anything for my horse.

cards.name: Siphon Soul
cards.text: Destroy a minion. Restore 3 Health to your hero.
cards.flavorText: You probably should avoid siphoning your own soul. You might create some kind of weird infinite loop.

cards.name: Siphoning Growth
cards.text: Destroy a friendly minion to gain 8 Armor.
cards.flavorText: No thanks. This one's all yours, bud.

cards.name: Sizzling Cinder
cards.text: Deathrattle:& Deal 2 damage randomly split among all enemies.
cards.flavorText: "Hey, I'm sizzlin' here!"

cards.name: Sizzling Swarm
cards.text: Deal 3 damage. Summon that many 2/1 Sizzling Cinders.
cards.flavorText: Can someone open a window? It's a little swarm in here!

cards.name: Skeletal Sidekick
cards.text: Battlecry: Give a friendly Undead +2 Attack.
cards.flavorText: He's got your back. And your arm.

cards.name: Skittish Saucier
cards.text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of adjacent cards in your hand by (1).
cards.flavorText: "Can I ask why this position was vacant?"

cards.name: Sky Raider
cards.text: Battlecry:& Add a random Pirate to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Maybe he should've hatched a plan that could actually carry booty back too.

cards.name: Skyscreamer Eggs
cards.text: Deathrattle:& Summon four 2/1 Hatchlings.
cards.flavorText: Aaaaaaaaaaahmlette

cards.name: Skywall Sentinel
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry: Herald Al'Akir.
cards.flavorText: I had no idea Al'Akir's first name was Herald.

cards.name: Slagclaw
cards.text: Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Sizzling Cinders. Kindred: Trigger your Sizzling Cinders' Deathrattles.
cards.flavorText: You can't just have the sizzle, you gotta have the cinders.

cards.name: Slam
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If it survives, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: "Dun da dun, dun da dun": if you've heard an ogre sing this, it's too late.

cards.name: Sleep Paralysis
cards.text: Choose One - Summon two 3/6 Demons with Taunt that can't attack; or Destroy an enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: The wild SPRITE is paralyzed! It can't sleep!

cards.name: Sleepy Dragon
cards.text: Taunt
cards.flavorText: Local villagers call her "Naps Under the Mountain."

cards.name: Sleet Storm
cards.text: Deal 2 damage. Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: Pocket snow!

cards.name: Slice and Dice
cards.text: Replay all other cards played this turn (targeting enemies if possible). End your turn.
cards.flavorText: It Preps, it Shivs, it Fans, it wins! Slice and Dice does it all!

cards.name: Slime 'em!
cards.text: Destroy all minions. Each player gets a 3-Cost spell that resummons theirs.
cards.flavorText: "Hell... it's about slime!"

cards.name: Slow Motion
cards.text: Your opponent's cards cost (1) more next turn.
cards.flavorText: You are now playing in Tortollan Mode.

cards.name: Slumbering Sprite
cards.text: Starts Dormant. After you use your Hero Power, this awakens.
cards.flavorText: Careful, sometimes he punches and screams when he wakes up.

cards.name: Small-Time Buccaneer
cards.text: Has +2 Attack while you have a weapon equipped.
cards.flavorText: "Oh, I'm not serious about it. I only pirate on the weekends."

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.text: Discover a Combo, Battlecry, or Stealth minion with a Dark Gift.
cards.flavorText: Wow, this blew up.

cards.name: Smoldering Ascent
cards.text: Deal damage to all enemy minions. (Upgrades each turn, but discards after !) Deal damage to all enemy minions. (Discards this turn!)
cards.flavorText: We all know what happens when you fly too close to the sun. But THIS is what happens when you fly straight into it.

cards.name: Smoldering Grove
cards.text: Draw (card, cards). (Upgrades each turn, but discards after !) Draw cards. (Discards this turn!)
cards.flavorText: To be clear, the grove is not SUPPOSED to be smoldering.

cards.name: Smoldering Strength
cards.text: Give a friendly minion + /+ . (Upgrades each turn, but discards after !) Give a friendly minion + /+ . (Discards this turn!)
cards.flavorText: You'll get it when you're smolder.

cards.name: Smuggled Shovel
cards.text: Deathrattle:& Draw a spell that didn't start in your deck.
cards.flavorText: I am a rat and I'm digging a hole. Diggy diggy hole, diggy diggy hole!

cards.name: Sneed's Old Shredder
cards.text: Deathrattle:& Summon a random Legendary minion.
cards.flavorText: When Sneed was defeated in the Deadmines, his shredder was sold at auction to an anonymous buyer. (Probably Hogger.)

cards.name: Soldier of the Bronze
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry:& Double this minion's Health.
cards.flavorText: This is what a century of bronzer does to you.

cards.name: Soldier of the Infinite
cards.text: Rush Battlecry:& Double this minion's Attack.
cards.flavorText: This is what a century of infinitizer does to you.

cards.name: Solitary Prisoner
cards.text: Costs (2) if there are no minions on the battlefield.
cards.flavorText: One arm bandit.

cards.name: Solitude
cards.text: Discover 2 minions. If your deck has no minions, reduce the Cost of any in your hand by (2).
cards.flavorText: Me time.

cards.name: Soothsayer
cards.text: Prepare, Taunt Deathrattle: Restore 6 Health to your hero.& Summon a random 6-Cost minion.
cards.flavorText: "Sooth. Sooth. ...Sooth. Am I doing it right?"

cards.name: Soul Immolation
cards.text: Your Hero Power becomes 'Collapsing Star'. If it already is, increase its damage by 1.
cards.flavorText: Is that a Soul Fragment? I haven't seen one of those since college!

cards.name: Soulrest Ceremony
cards.text: Give your minions +1 Attack and Rush. They die at the end of your turn.
cards.flavorText: When you're looking for lethal, you might have to break a few eggs.

cards.name: Southsea Captain
cards.text: Your other Pirates have +1/+1.
cards.flavorText: When he saves enough plunder, he's going to commission an enormous captain's hat. He has hat envy.

cards.name: Spark of Life
cards.text: Choose One - Discover a Mage spell; or Discover a Druid spell.
cards.flavorText: Just don't spark that life too close to the World Tree.

cards.name: Spawn of C'Thun
cards.text: Battlecry: If C'Thun started in your deck, choose one of its abilities to trigger.
cards.flavorText: If it manages to reach the other side of the battlefield it becomes the Squeen of C'Thun.

cards.name: Spearheart Sentry
cards.text: At the end of your turn,& get a random Holy spell. Reduce its Cost by (3).
cards.flavorText: "I'm all better now, I got the spear out."

cards.name: Specter Specialist
cards.text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion Reborn. If it already has Reborn, summon a copy of it.
cards.flavorText: She ain't afraid of no ghosts!

cards.name: Specter of Despair
cards.text: Taunt Can't attack.
cards.flavorText: This is so sad. Azalina play Despaircito.

cards.name: Spectral Sight
cards.text: Draw a card. Outcast: Draw another.
cards.flavorText: "Pick a card, any card! Preferably the left- or right-most card."

cards.name: Spellweaver's Brilliance
cards.text: Summon a 6/6 Dragon. Costs (1) less for each damage you dealt with spells this turn.
cards.flavorText: Oh you think you're sooOOOOooo smart? *pyroblasts them*

cards.name: Spelunker
cards.text: Battlecry:& Your next Temporary card costs (2) less.
cards.flavorText: Echo... echo... repeatable this turn...

cards.name: Spider Rider
cards.text: After your hero attacks,& draw a card.
cards.flavorText: SPIDER JOCKEY

cards.name: Spiderling
cards.text: Your hero has +1 Attack on your turn.
cards.flavorText: Yes chef!

cards.name: Spikeridged Steed
cards.text: Give a minion +2/+6 and Taunt. When it dies, summon a Stegodon.
cards.flavorText: What beats cavalry? Dinosaur cavalry.

cards.name: Spire Security
cards.text: Battlecry: Reveal a spell in your deck. If it costs (5) or more,& deal 5 damage split among enemy minions.
cards.flavorText: One does not simply walk out of The Violet Hold. Its gates are guarded by more than just Boulderfist Ogres. There is evil there that does not sleep, and Spire Security's great eye is ever watchful.

cards.name: Spire of Solitude
cards.text: Summon a Demon with stats equal to your hand size. It attacks a random enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: Ah, an introvert's dream!

cards.name: Spirit Bomb
cards.text: Deal 4 damage to a minion and your hero.
cards.flavorText: Might take a few episodes to power up.

cards.name: Spirit Bond
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, summon a 3/2 Wolf with Rush.
cards.flavorText: The name's Bond. Spirit Bond.

cards.name: Spirit Gatherer
cards.text: Battlecry: Get a Wisp. Imbue your Hero Power.
cards.flavorText: They call him the Wisp Whisperer.

cards.name: Spirit of the Kaldorei
cards.text: Taunt, Lifesteal Battlecry: If you used your Hero Power this turn, gain +3/+3.
cards.flavorText: We brought magic to this world, but destruction may take it away.

cards.name: Spirit of the Mountain
cards.text: Quest: Play 6 minions of unique types. Reward: Ashalon.
cards.flavorText: Day 10. A Tortollan named Bralma took Niri, Elise, and I deep into the mountain. She showed us how the Tortollans move lava up from the base of the volcano through a system of “lavaqueducts.” I was shocked to find a pack of Volcanosaurs living there!

cards.name: Spirits of the Forest
cards.text: Choose One - Summon three 2/3 Wolves with Taunt; or Summon two 4/3 Falcons with Windfury.
cards.flavorText: ...or sixteen cows.

cards.name: Spiritspeaker
cards.text: Battlecry:& Choose an Animal Companion to summon.
cards.flavorText: "What did the spirit say?" "Caaaw!"

cards.name: Spiteful Chef
cards.text: Battlecry: Summon a 2-Cost Taunt minion. If you have 10 or more Mana, summon a 6-Cost instead.
cards.flavorText: All I said was that it needed a touch more salt!

cards.name: Splintered Reality
cards.text: Summon two 2/2 Treants. They gain +1/+1 for each friendly Treant that died this game. ( )
cards.flavorText: I want to go to a reality where I didn't get splinters.

cards.name: Sporegnasher
cards.text: Poisonous Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: The overbite of a century.

cards.name: Spymistress
cards.text: Stealth
cards.flavorText: Spies in Outland must blend into the environment. That means hot-pink gear and bright green hair. It’s a weird place.

cards.name: Stadium Announcer
cards.text: Rewind Battlecry: Both players equip a random weapon. Give yours +1/+1.
cards.flavorText: "ATTENTION!" "CANNONBALL!"

cards.name: Staff of Trickery
cards.text: After your hero attacks, Discover a Druid card. Reduce its Cost by your hero's Attack.
cards.flavorText: It's tricky to get a 'vate, to get a 'vate that's not too late - it's tricky!

cards.name: Staff of the Endbringer
cards.text: Deathrattle:& Destroy all minions.
cards.flavorText: Finally, the loot I wanted off the boss! Too bad I'm on an alt...

cards.name: Stardust Scythe
cards.text: After your hero attacks,& get a Void Soul.
cards.flavorText: Isn't ALL dust, stardust?

cards.name: Starsurge
cards.text: Deal damage to a minion. (Improved by each friendly minion that died this game.)
cards.flavorText: "The stars urge you to DIE."

cards.name: Static Shock
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to a minion. Give your hero +1 Attack this turn.
cards.flavorText: Spent hours shuffling his feet on the rug before going into battle.

cards.name: Steamcleaner
cards.text: Battlecry: Destroy ALL cards in both players' decks that didn't start there.
cards.flavorText: Business is slow since the anima shortage began. Things just don't get stained like they used to!

cards.name: Steamfin Thief
cards.text: Kindred:& Summon two 1/1 Murlocs with Rush.
cards.flavorText: Dial M for Murlocs.

cards.name: Stellar Balance
cards.text: Get a Moonfire and a Starfire. Give them Spell Damage +1.
cards.flavorText: Famously, Moonfire and Starfire are about equal in power.

cards.name: Steward of the Vale
cards.text: Battlecry: Assemble a Beast.
cards.flavorText: You craft more flies with honey than vinegar.

cards.name: Stickybomb Saboteur
cards.text: Battlecry: Give your opponent a 2-Cost Sabotage. Cards next to it cost (1) more.
cards.flavorText: Her over-attachment to her work proved fatal.

cards.name: Stolen Power
cards.text: Get a random Shatter card from another class. (It's already combined).
cards.flavorText: Your powers are mine!

cards.name: Stone Gauntlet
cards.text: After your hero attacks, convert 5 of your hero's Health to Armor.
cards.flavorText: Fine, I'll do it myself.

cards.name: Stone Trogg
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage to a minion. If it survives, gain +6 Health and Taunt.
cards.flavorText: Literal embodiment of "If at first you don't succeed, try, try again."

cards.name: Stonecarver
cards.text: At the end of your turn,& give another friendly damaged minion +2/+2.
cards.flavorText: *clink* *clink* *clink* *"D'oh!"

cards.name: Stonehill Defender
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry: Discover a Taunt minion.
cards.flavorText: Briefly tried stand-up comedy under the name "Stonehill Offender", but turtles are just too thin-skinned.

cards.name: Stonetalon Striker
cards.text: Taunt (While in hand, play a Dragon to become a 6/6 Dragon!)
cards.flavorText: Are there any other secret Dragons I should know about!?

cards.name: Storage Scuffle
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Costs (0) if you've Discovered this turn.
cards.flavorText: Flip and file! Mix and shuffle! Sort and swap! Do the Storage Scuffle!

cards.name: Storm the Gates
cards.text: Sidequest: Play 3 Beasts or Undead. Reward: Craft a custom Zombeast. It costs (3) less.
cards.flavorText: Have fun storming the Lost City!

cards.name: Stormbinder
cards.text: Deathrattle: Unlock your Overloaded Mana Crystals. Overload: (3)
cards.flavorText: Random Orc looking out at rain: "Well, you can't change the weather." Stormbinder: "Hold my totem."

cards.name: Stormbrewer
cards.text: Whenever this attacks, deal 3 damage to the target first. Kindred: Gain Rush.
cards.flavorText: It was a dark and stormy Elemental...

cards.name: Stormfury
cards.text: Lifesteal. Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions. (Cast (spell, spells) to turn into a minion!)
cards.flavorText: UNLIMITED POWER!!!

cards.name: Stormrook
cards.text: Whenever you would damage this with a Nature spell, summon a random 5-Cost minion instead.
cards.flavorText: A dwarf and their rook have a special bond, which cannot be broken by forge nor fire.

cards.name: Stormwind Champion
cards.text: Your other minions have +1/+1.
cards.flavorText: When Deathwing assaulted the capital, this soldier was the only member of his squad to survive. Now he's all bitter and stuff.

cards.name: Story of Amara
cards.text: Set your hero's Health to 40.
cards.flavorText: "Once upon a time... ok how about we just skip to the end?"

cards.name: Story of Barnabus
cards.text: Draw a minion. If it has 5 or more Attack, give it +5 Health and gain 5 Armor.
cards.flavorText: "Once there was a giant dinosaur. He was so giant that everyone died. The end."

cards.name: Story of Carnassa
cards.text: Shuffle ten 1-Cost 3/2 Raptors into your deck with "Battlecry: Draw a card."
cards.flavorText: "... and ALL TEN Raptors were at the top of the deck!"

cards.name: Story of Galvadon
cards.text: Give a minion three random Bonus Effects.
cards.flavorText: "...so I gave him +12 Attack and Windfury -- and you won't believe this -- he LIVED."

cards.name: Story of Lakkari
cards.text: At the end of your turn, discard a card and fill your board with 3/2 Imps. Lasts 3 turns.
cards.flavorText: Wow, the Tortollans really embellish these stories.

cards.name: Story of Sulfuras
cards.text: Swap your Hero Power to "Deal 8 damage to a random enemy." After 2 uses, swap back.
cards.flavorText: "...and there were seven minions on board, and it STILL hit the enemy hero!"

cards.name: Story of Umbra
cards.text: Discover a Deathrattle minion that costs (5) or more. Summon it and trigger its Deathrattle.
cards.flavorText: "She tried to tell people about our secret city, so we kicked her out of our secret city. That'll show her!"

cards.name: Story of the Waygate
cards.text: Reduce the Cost of cards in your hand that didn't start in your deck by (1).
cards.flavorText: "...and then a lot of people got mad."

cards.name: Stranglethorn Tiger
cards.text: Stealth
cards.flavorText: The wonderful thing about tigers is tigers are wonderful things!

cards.name: Stranglevine
cards.text: Deathrattle: Give a random friendly minion a random Bonus Effect and this Deathrattle.
cards.flavorText: "Wow, this human's head is perfectly mouth-shaped."

cards.name: Submerged Map
cards.text: Discover a Murloc. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
cards.flavorText: Sure, it leads straight to Latorvia. How long can you hold your breath?

cards.artistName: L. Lullabi & I. Campelo da Silva
cards.name: Succumb to Madness
cards.text: Discover a friendly Dragon that died this game. Resummon it.
cards.flavorText: u mad bro?

cards.name: Sun's Reckoning
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions. Shuffle 'Final Reckoning' into your deck.
cards.flavorText: The sun is a deadly laser.

cards.name: Sundancer
cards.text: At the end of your turn, get a 2-Cost Blessing that gives +2/+3.
cards.flavorText: We can sun-dance if we want to!

cards.name: Sunfury Protector
cards.text: Battlecry: Give adjacent minions Taunt.
cards.flavorText: She carries a shield, but only so she can give it to someone she can stand behind.

cards.name: Supply Run
cards.text: Shatter Draw 3 minions. Give minions in your hand +2/+2. Draw 3 minions. Give minions in your hand +2/+2.
cards.flavorText: DrakeDash was key in delivering victory against Al'Akir.

cards.name: Supreme Dinomancy
cards.text: Give +2/+2 to all Beasts in your hand, deck, and battlefield.
cards.flavorText: Not anyone can be a great dinomancer. But a great dinomancer can come from anywhere.

cards.name: Surge Needle
cards.text: Battlecry: Your Leylines trigger an additional time this game.
cards.flavorText: Scalpel... Tweezers... Surge Needle... I said Surge Needle!

cards.name: Survivalist
cards.text: Has Immune while you control no other minions.
cards.flavorText: "Go - save yourself and your ranking!"

cards.name: Swamp Leech
cards.text: Lifesteal
cards.flavorText: A face only a druid could love.

cards.name: Swashburglar
cards.text: Battlecry:& Add a random card from another class to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Was almost named "Swashb-AAAARRHHH-gler"

cards.name: Sylvanas's Triumph
cards.text: Deal 3 damage. If you've played another copy of this, hit all enemies instead.
cards.flavorText: What lies in her future is still unwritten. For now, this version of Sylvanas fights valiantly to defend Azeroth with her sisters at her side.

cards.name: Symbiosis
cards.text: Discover a Choose One card from another class.
cards.flavorText: It's the circle of life.

cards.name: Synchronized Spark
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy. If it dies, give a random friendly minion +3/+3.
cards.flavorText: Sparkle on! It's the End Time! Don't forget to be yourself!

cards.name: TREEEES!!!
cards.text: Choose a minion. Summon four 2/2 Treants that attack it.
cards.flavorText: Photo synth THIS, fool!

cards.name: Tachyon Barrage
cards.text: Deal 6 damage split among all enemies. Shuffle 2 Shreds of Time into your deck.
cards.flavorText: Kinda tachy if you ask me.

cards.name: Taelan Fordring
cards.text: Taunt, Divine Shield Deathrattle:& Draw your highest Cost minion.
cards.flavorText: After growing up with the Scarlet Crusade for most of his life, Taelan finally realized they were maybe not the nicest people.

cards.name: Talanji of the Graves
cards.text: Fabled. Battlecry: Draw Bwonsamdi (or resurrect him if he has died). Choose a Boon to give him.
cards.flavorText: In one dark timeline, Talanji was struck down and raised again as a death knight. But even death can't stop her from protecting the Zandalari.

cards.name: Talanji's Last Stand
cards.text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Summon a random 4-Cost minion."
cards.flavorText: Talanji's relationship with Bwonsamdi was never easy or uncomplicated. But when the time came to lead Zandalar against Deathwing's forces, the two fought side by side.

cards.name: Talya Earthstrider
cards.text: Battlecry: Your cards that summon Animal Companions summon 1 more this game.
cards.flavorText: She's a cat lady... and an Elekk lady... and an Ultrasaur lady.

cards.name: Tame Pet
cards.text: Replace your future Animal Companions with random Beasts that cost (1) more. Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: Finally, it's never Huffer.

cards.name: Tank Regiment
cards.text: Battlecry: Summon two copies of this. Deathrattle: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
cards.flavorText: I can see my house from here! Uh oh...

cards.name: Tankgineer
cards.text: Divine Shield Deathrattle: Summon a 7/7 Tank with Divine Shield.
cards.flavorText: They can fix anything, as long as it's a tank.

cards.name: Tar Creeper
cards.text: Taunt Has +2 Attack during your opponent's turn.
cards.flavorText: If you won't come to the tar pits, we'll bring them to you!

cards.name: Tar Tyrant
cards.text: Taunt, Lifesteal Has +6 Attack during your opponent's turn.
cards.flavorText: Why would they put a waterfall here if there wasn't something cool behind it?

cards.name: Teamwork
cards.text: Summon and get four Silver Hand Recruits.
cards.flavorText: Uh, yeah, I sure hope it does.

cards.name: Techysaurus
cards.text: Taunt. Costs (1) less for each card you played this game that didn't start in your deck.
cards.flavorText: The field of dino prosthetics was nearly extinct before the Tortollans came around.

cards.name: Temporal Construct
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage to an enemy minion. Draw cards equal to the excess damage.
cards.flavorText: Time is a construct. Here it is.

cards.name: Temporal Traveler
cards.text: Deathrattle: Summon a 4/1 Shadow that attacks a random enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: Note to past self: remember to avenge my imminent death.

cards.name: Tending Dragonkin
cards.text: Battlecry:& Copy the lowest Cost Beast in your hand.
cards.flavorText: Dogs are a dragon's best friend.

cards.name: Tentacle Lash
cards.text: After your hero attacks, reduce the Cost of C'Thun by (1). Choose a C'Thun ability to trigger.
cards.flavorText: By the power of C'Thun. I HAVE THE POWER!

cards.name: Terror of the Wastes
cards.text: Battlecry: If a friendly minion died this turn, attack a random enemy.
cards.flavorText: Absolutely snatched.

cards.name: Thassarian
cards.text: Reborn Battlecry and Deathrattle:& Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
cards.flavorText: A natural born leader. And an unnatural reborn leader.

cards.name: Thaw From Ice
cards.text: Assemble a Mage minion. At the end of your turns, reduce its Cost by (1).
cards.flavorText: Ah shoot I forgot to take the minion out of the freezer.

cards.name: The Arcanomicon
cards.text: Get all 3 Leylines. Choose an upgrade for your Leylines.
cards.flavorText: Pondering my Orb.

cards.name: The Black Blood
cards.text: Colossal +3. After you restore Health to a character,& attack a random enemy minion.
cards.flavorText: As cunning as she is hateful, Sinestra summoned the Black Blood from deep within the earth to mutate and empower her forces.

cards.name: The Black Knight
cards.text: Tradeable Battlecry: Destroy an enemy minion with Taunt.
cards.flavorText: He was sent by the Lich King to disrupt the Argent Tournament. We can pretty much mark that a failure.

cards.name: The Cold Dark Void
cards.text: Deal 4 damage to a minion and 2 damage to its neighbors.
cards.flavorText: Back in my day, we had NOTHING and we liked it!

cards.name: The Curator
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry:& Draw a Beast, Dragon, and Murloc.
cards.flavorText: The Curator guards Azeroth’s deadliest creatures, but it’s secretly terrified of squirrels.

cards.name: The Egg of Khelos
cards.text: Deathrattle: Summon a slightly cracked Egg. (Break 5 times to hatch a 20/20 Beast with Taunt!)
cards.flavorText: Thousands upon thousands of years Khelos has been waiting to hatch. Hopefully you won't have to wait that long.

cards.name: The Eternal Hold

cards.flavorText: "Watch out for my WAVE OF TAR!!! Just... stand still for a minute."

cards.name: Waveshaping
cards.text: Discover a card from your deck. The others get put on the bottom.
cards.flavorText: I wave in squares.

cards.name: Weaver of the Cycle
cards.text: Battlecry: If you're holding a spell that costs (5) or more, deal 3 damage.
cards.flavorText: A terror at spin class.

cards.name: Web of Deception
cards.text: Return a friendly minion to your hand to summon a 4/4 Spider with Stealth.
cards.flavorText: You sit on a web of LIES!

cards.name: Welcome Home!
cards.text: Reopen a location. Give it "Deathrattle: Summon a random 3-Cost minion."
cards.flavorText: Kick off your boots, light the hearth, and deal a fresh hand!

cards.name: Whelp of the Bronze
cards.text: Lifesteal Divine Shield
cards.flavorText: What a cutie pie.

cards.name: Whelp of the Infinite
cards.text: Poisonous Reborn
cards.flavorText: .eip eituc a tahW

cards.name: Whirling Stormdrake
cards.text: Rush, Windfury Kindred: Gain Immune this turn.
cards.flavorText: Summons storms. Breathes fire. But first, does a sick loop-de-loop.

cards.name: Whispering Stone
cards.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Get 2 random Fel spells. They cost Health instead of Mana.
cards.flavorText: shhhhhh...

cards.name: Wicked Blightspawn
cards.text: Reborn. Deathrattle: Equip a 1/2 Dagger. If you already have a weapon equipped, give it +2 Attack instead.
cards.flavorText: We had to split this minion's Deathrattle into two parts.

cards.name: Wickerfang
cards.text: Colossal +4 After one of Wickerfang's Legs gains stats, this gains them too.
cards.flavorText: In their time of need, Merithra of the Dream led the Timbermaw furbolgs in a ritual that animated the Felwood's oldest tree.

cards.name: Widow's Bite
cards.text: Give your hero +1 Attack this turn. Gain 1 Armor. Add "Widow's Feast" to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Spider Bake Sale. All proceeds go to real spiders.

cards.name: Wild Pyromancer
cards.text: After you cast a spell,& deal 1 damage to ALL minions.
cards.flavorText: BOOM BABY BOOM! BAD IS GOOD! DOWN WITH GOVERNMENT!

cards.name: Wildwood Circle
cards.text: Shatter. Summon two 2/2 Treants. Give your minions "Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Treant." Summon two 2/2 Treants. Give your minions "Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Treant."
cards.flavorText: Let's circle back after we've played more cards.

cards.name: Willful Watcher
cards.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Destroy the top 3 cards of your deck.
cards.flavorText: I still don't know why he has a sword. Despite being in many battles, he really just watches.

cards.name: Wilted Shadow
cards.text: Lifesteal Whenever you heal an enemy, this attacks it.
cards.flavorText: The shadow shall burn you!

cards.name: Windpeak Wyrm
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage and gain 5 Armor. Kindred: Costs (3) less.
cards.flavorText: He's so anxious. Always winds up in knots.

cards.name: Windswept Pageturner
cards.text: After you summon an Elemental,& deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
cards.flavorText: This story will blow you away.

cards.name: Winged Aberration
cards.text: Rush Combo: Overload for (2) to gain Immune this turn and Windfury.
cards.flavorText: This bucket of chicken comes with an extra wing!

cards.name: Wings of Eternity
cards.text: Discover a Dragon from the past with a Dark Gift.
cards.flavorText: I can't wait for Temporus with double Battlecry.

cards.name: Winterspring Whelp
cards.text: Battlecry:& Discover a 1-Cost spell from any class.
cards.flavorText: It's important to explore other classes while learning to spread your wings!

cards.name: Wish of the New Moon
cards.text: Deal 6 damage to a minion. (Cast (spell, spells) to gain Lifesteal.)
cards.flavorText: Because wishing upon a star was soooo last expansion.

cards.name: Wisprider
cards.text: Battlecry: Imbue your Hero Power, then trigger it.
cards.flavorText: "I surf dead people."

cards.name: Witch's Apprentice
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry: Add a random Shaman spell to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Is she a frog that became a witch, or a witch that became a frog?

cards.name: Witchwood Grizzly
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry: Lose 1 Health for each card in your opponent's hand.
cards.flavorText: You know what they say about people with big hands? Small bears.

cards.name: Wizened Truthseeker
cards.text: Battlecry: Set the Cost of every card in both player's hands back to their original Costs.
cards.flavorText: All his stories start with "Back in my day..."

cards.name: Wizened Wildspeaker
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry: If you didn't play a minion last turn, refresh 3 Mana Crystals.
cards.flavorText: He's not old, he's "Wizened".

cards.name: Worgen Infiltrator
cards.text: Stealth
cards.flavorText: If you want to stop a worgen from infiltrating, just yell, "No! Bad boy!"

cards.name: Wormhole
cards.text: Rewind Summon a random 3-Cost Beast. It attacks a random enemy.
cards.flavorText: Worms sourced cruelty free from Gigantic Sam's Bait Shoppe.

cards.name: Wormriddled Wriggler
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand to shuffle into your deck. It costs (1) less.
cards.flavorText: The early Shadewing gets the wriggler.

cards.name: Wound Prey
cards.text: Deal 1 damage. Summon a 1/1 Hyena with Rush.
cards.flavorText: You steal the cranberry juice, you pay the price.

cards.name: Wrath
cards.text: Choose One - Deal 3 damage to a minion; or 1 damage and draw a card.
cards.flavorText: The talk around the Ratchet Inn is that this card is too good and should be a Legendary.

cards.name: Wrathspike Brute
cards.text: Taunt After this is attacked, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavorText: You scratch her back, her back scratches back.

cards.name: Wyvern's Slumber
cards.text: Choose One - Summon two Dormant Dreadseeds; or Deal 2 damage to all minions.
cards.flavorText: But watch, as soon as you try to go to sleep it'll be running all around the house making a bunch of noise.

cards.name: Xel'noth Behemoth
cards.text: Deathrattle: Summon two random 1-Cost minions. Give your minions +3 Attack.
cards.flavorText: It would be truly terrifying if a void creature came forth from the void with an un-apostrophized name.

cards.name: Y'Shaarj, Titan Bane
cards.text: Old God. Battlecry: If you've spent 30 Mana on minions this game, gain Immune for 1 turn. (30 left!)
cards.flavorText: "Gargantuan Slitherer" + "Kronn the Impaler" + ("Therazane the Earthmother" - "Neptulon, Lord of Tides")

cards.name: Yesterloc
cards.text: At the end of your turn,& give your other minions +1 Health.
cards.flavorText: *nostalgic mrrgls*

cards.name: Ysera, Emerald Aspect
cards.text: Start of Game: Increase both players'maximum Mana by 5. Battlecry: Gain 3 Mana Crystals.
cards.flavorText: She was previously Yuhsera, with a ‘yuh’.

cards.name: Ysondre
cards.text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Summon a random Dragon for each time Ysondre has died this game.
cards.flavorText: Because sondre!

cards.name: Zakajz the Corruptor
cards.text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of minions in your hand and deck by (1) and increase the Cost of spells by (1).
cards.flavorText: WHERE ARE MY TOOTHBRUSHES!!!

cards.name: Zaqali Flamemancer
cards.text: Battlecry: If every card in your hand is of a different Cost, reduce their Costs by (2).
cards.flavorText: What's the difference between a pyromancer and a flamemancer? One knows their Greek roots, the other BURNS THEM DOWN!

cards.name: Zer'Ontu
cards.text: Taunt. Battlecry: Summon a 0, 1, and 2-Attack minion from your deck. Gain their stats.
cards.flavorText: Do Zer'Onto others as you would have them do Zer'Ontu you.

cards.name: Zuramat's Prison
cards.text: Choose a card to discard to summon a 5/5 Taunt. Deathrattle: Free Zuramat who plays one each turn!
cards.flavorText: WETVAC MODE ACTIVATE!
